cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

relationship.evidence: B2 has paid plans and B4 a promise to a friend, so A must accommodate real commitments.

heightening.evidence: B4 dancing obligation produces A5 cleared room and music choice, advancing the same bid for company.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday versus concert establishes immediate competing plans and cake as an invitation.
